title: VLOOKUP pulls the wrong column after someone inserts one

payoff.headline:
VLOOKUP COUNTS
COLUMNS
payoff.sub: Insert one column and column two quietly means something else.

script.vo: Any formula that counts columns is one insert away from quietly lying to you.

post.title: VLOOKUP returns the wrong column after inserting a column
post.description:
vlookup returns wrong value after inserting a column in excel
VLOOKUP's column number is just a count, so an inserted column silently changes what column two means. XLOOKUP names the column you want and survives the insert. Needs Microsoft 365 or Excel 2021.
